prompt:
Fix snippets/volume-discount-ladder.liquid so that it renders a quantity-discount ladder and picks the correct tier when rules overlap. Render it with strict core Liquid only. Do not use Shopify objects or filters. Inputs (all top-level variables): - `quantity`: integer >= 1, or null. Null means 1. - `unit_price`: integer price in cents, >= 0. Never null. - `tiers`: array of objects, or null. An empty array and null are treated the same way. Every tier object always has these keys: - `min`: integer, never null. - `max`: integer or null. Null means no upper bound. - `percent`: integer 0-100, never null. - `label`: string or null. - `exclusive`: boolean or null. Null means false. Matching: a tier matches when min <= quantity, and either max is null or quantity <= max. Winner selection among matching tiers, in priority order: 1. If any matching tier has `exclusive` true, the winner is the first such tier in list order. Its percent applies even if non-exclusive tiers offer more. 2. Otherwise, the winner is the matching tier with the highest percent. If percents are tied, the tier listed first wins. 3. If no tier matches, there is no winner and the percent is 0. Total: - total_cents = (unit_price * quantity * (100 - winning_percent)) divided by 100. - Use integer division, rounding down. - Format the total as `$D.CC`: - D is total_cents divided by 100 (integer, no thousands separators). - CC is total_cents modulo 100, always two digits with zero padding (e.g. `$0.07`, `$45.00`). Labels: - Strip whitespace from `label`. If the result is empty, or the value is null, use a generated label: - `Buy MIN+` when max is null. - `Buy MIN-MAX` otherwise, with a plain hyphen. - HTML-escape the final label. Output: `
` + OL + SAVING + `

$D.CC

` - OL is omitted entirely when there are no tiers. Otherwise it is `
    ` + one entry per tier in input order + `
`. Each entry is `
  • LABELP% off
    • `, where P is that tier's own percent. The winning tier's li instead has `class="tier tier--active"`. - SAVING is `

    Save W%

    ` when the winning percent W is greater than 0. Otherwise it is omitted, including when there is no winner or the winner has 0%. Emit no whitespace or newlines between or around any tags. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/volume-discount-ladder.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
